Transcribe every Egyptian hieroglyph on the page as Unicode Egyptian Hieroglyphs (code points U+13000–U+1342F), in reading order, one line of output per line or column of the original. Output ONLY hieroglyph characters and newlines: no transliteration, no translation, no Gardiner codes, no commentary, no Latin or German text. Skip hatched (damaged) areas.
